subject.title: feat: add guarded FakeCo AWS owner

question: After the SSM artifact IAM defect is repaired, must this exact head complete authenticated FakeCo AWS plan/apply/verify/restore/teardown proof before merge, or may the repository owner waive that external proof requirement?
rationale: Repository-local tests cannot validate the real protected Environment, OIDC trust, CloudFormation service role, SSM execution, backup/restore, and retained-data teardown in the dedicated member account.

options.title: Require authenticated lifecycle proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted preflight, plan, apply, verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown output is posted.

options.title: Waive proof for this head
options.body: An owner explicitly accepts the remaining account-specific execution uncertainty after reviewing the repaired exact head.

recommendation.title: Require authenticated lifecycle proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted preflight, plan, apply, verify, backup/restore, snapshot, and retained-data teardown output is posted.
